[SWS_CM_10523] Silently discarding trigger for unsubscribed triggers
⌈
If the trigger identified according to [SWS_CM_10514] does not have an active sub-
scription because the Subscribe method (see [SWS_CM_00723]) of the specific
Trigger class of the ServiceProxy class has not been called, or the Unsubscribe
method (see [SWS_CM_00810]) of the specific Trigger class of the ServiceProxy
class has been called, or the TTL of the SOME/IP SubscribeEventgroup message (see
[SWS_CM_00205]) has expired, then the received trigger shall be silently discarded
(i.e., [SWS_CM_00226], and [SWS_CM_00249] shall not be performed).
⌋
